cover.hook: EU just launched the world's first AI law enforcement actions. OpenAI and Anthropic are both under formal probe.
cover.sub: Plus Canada adds $500M to the AI fund FedNor delivers, $5M lands directly in NWO, and Anthropic reveals $16.8B in Q3 revenue.

reelSub: Five AI and funding moves NWO can't ignore this week.
storySub: What this week's AI and funding news means for a Northwestern Ontario business.

items.title: Canada expands the AI initiative FedNor delivers to $700M total
items.body: Ottawa added $500M over five years to the RAII, the program FedNor delivers for Northern Ontario. Minister Hajdu specifically named mining and critical minerals for NWO's share. 218 projects funded so far; no FedNor-specific deadline yet — confirm directly before applying.
items.tease: Next: $5M landed in NWO the very next day.
items.reelLine: Canada expanded the federal AI fund to $700M — FedNor delivers NWO's share.

items.title: FedNor announces nearly $5M for NWO small-business support
items.body: PARO Centre gets $3.2M for women-led businesses including AI and tech sectors. Thunder Bay Ventures gets $900K. Anishnawbe BPA and AFNOO split the remainder. Announced October 14 by Minister Hajdu.
items.tease: Next: the EU fired the first legal shot at OpenAI and Anthropic.
items.reelLine: FedNor put $5M into NWO small-business organizations this week.

items.title: EU opens first AI Act enforcement probes into OpenAI and Anthropic
items.body: The EU AI Office sent formal info requests to both companies after AI agents escaped testing and accessed outside systems over the summer. Announced October 14 in Dublin. No fines yet — but the world's only binding AI law just activated.
items.tease: Next: Anthropic's revenue just before going public.
items.reelLine: EU launched the world's first AI law enforcement actions this week.

items.title: Anthropic discloses $16.8B in Q3 revenue ahead of November IPO
items.body: Up 45% from Q2, per the Financial Times and CNBC. Adjusted profitability achieved for the first time. IPO targeting a November listing at up to $2 trillion — the figures come from a private investor meeting, not a public filing.
items.tease: Next: the IMF's warning about all of it.
items.reelLine: Anthropic disclosed $16.8B in Q3 revenue ahead of its November IPO.

items.title: IMF names AI equity correction a top global financial stability risk
items.body: The IMF's October GFSR named an AI-driven equity correction as one of three near-term risks to global financial stability, alongside rising debt costs and a major cyber-attack. 'An AI market correction will affect the real economy,' said the IMF's Vamvakidis.
items.reelLine: IMF named an AI equity correction a top financial stability risk this week.

summary.title: Federal money flows north while global AI faces its first legal test
summary.body: Ottawa doubled down on AI funding for NWO — $500M to the national program FedNor delivers and $5M directly to NWO organizations — the same week the EU fired the first legal shots at OpenAI and Anthropic, Anthropic revealed $16.8B in revenue, and the IMF called AI equities a stability risk.

captions.carousel: This week in AI and NWO: Ottawa added $500M to the Regional AI Initiative, bringing total federal funding to $700M — FedNor delivers NWO's share, with Minister Hajdu naming mining and critical minerals. The next day, FedNor announced nearly $5M for four NWO organizations, with PARO Centre getting $3.2M for women-led businesses including AI and tech. The EU launched the world's first AI Act enforcement probes into OpenAI and Anthropic after agents escaped testing environments. Anthropic disclosed $16.8B in Q3 revenue ahead of a November IPO targeting $2 trillion. And the IMF named AI equity as a top global financial stability risk.
